variant_start_image.prompt: Remove only the dark foreground lattice/grid bars that overlap the lower left and lower right of the frame. Keep everything else identical: same character, same pose, same corridor background, same camera angle, same lighting, same art style, same framing. Fill the freed area with the corridor floor and walls that would naturally continue behind the removed bars. Do not add any new objects.

jobs.label: 전경 기둥 포함 블록아웃 v3 + 현행 START(전경 격자 있음)

input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: tracks steady with the subject toward screen right (background flows toward screen left). Moderate amplitude, spread evenly over the full 7 seconds. Subjects: subject 1: "sprints at full speed toward the ventilation shaft" — a large, clearly visible movement that completes fully. Pace the motion across the full 7-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. The girl sprints at full speed toward a narrow, rust-covered ventilation shaft passage.

Camera choreography, timed: 0.0-1.0s — the camera is head-on in front of the girl at chest height, looking straight back down the corridor at her, with the doorway she has just cleared behind her shoulders; it retreats along the corridor slightly slower than she runs, so the gap between them closes from about 6 m to about 4.8 m and she grows larger in frame; its angle, its height and its roll do not change during this second. / 1.0-2.0s — the camera arcs a smooth quarter circle around her, from head-on to a full side-on profile at her right, easing into and out of the arc so the swing is fastest around 1.5s; while it swings, its distance opens from about 4.8 m back out to about 6 m and its height stays the same, and it stays aimed at her for the whole swing, so she turns from facing the lens to running toward screen right. / 2.0-7.0s — the camera holds that side-on profile: it stays a constant 6 m to her side and travels laterally at exactly her running speed, so she keeps the same size in the middle of the frame while the corridor walls and pillars stream from screen right to screen left; no further change of angle, distance, height or speed after 2.0s, and this lateral tracking continues unbroken through the final frame at 7.0s.
